data.name: Tejendra
data.gender_notes: Tejendra is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: God of Power, God of Energy
data.long_meaning: Tejendra is a name of Lord Indra, the Hindu God of Rain, Storm, and Power. He is the King of the Devas and the ruler of the heavens. The name Tejendra comes from the Sanskrit words 'Tejas' meaning 'Might, Power, Energy' and 'Indra' meaning 'King, Ruler'. Tejendra represents the embodiment of power and strength. The name Tejendra carries the meaning “God of Power, God of Energy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Tejendra usually hope their child will grow to embody god of power, god of energy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Tejendra is a name of Lord Indra, the Hindu God of Rain, Storm, and Power. He is the King of the Devas and the ruler of the heavens. Tejendra represents the embodiment of power, strength, and energy. He is the protector of the universe and the giver of life-giving rain.
data.etymology: Tejendra belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Power, God of Energy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tejendra total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: Lord Indra is a significant deity in Hindu culture, especially in agricultural societies where the survival and prosperity of crops depended on the rain. He is often depicted with a thunderbolt, and is invited to weddings to bring blessings of rain and fertility.
data.spiritual_significance: Lord Indra represents the desire for power and strength in individuals, as well as the power and energy present in all aspects of creation. He is a reminder that inner strength and determination are essential for personal growth and spiritual evolution.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Tejendra: Radiant with divine energy and power. Master of Tej, the lightning bolt, representing illumination and change.
